title: Green Bean Casserole With Mushrooms (or Not)
description:
From Ahead of Thyme: Green bean casserole is a classic holiday side dish packed with fresh green beans in a
delicious creamy mushroom sauce, and topped with crispy fried onions. Don’t hesitate to use the store-bought
French-fried onions in a can (such as French’s). They cannot be improved.
And, if you’re making this for kids who don’t particularly like mushrooms, leave them out.
ingredients: 1 ½ lbs. green beans (haricot vert preferred), ends trimmed and cut in half
3 cups brown mushrooms, sliced (about ½ lb.) [optional]
2 cups heavy cream (or half and half cream)
1 ½ cups French fried onions, homemade or store-bought
